objective: Make the BUKLOD Public Wall header compact by placing FOLLOW/FOLLOWING alongside the author name and Edit/Report overflow directly beneath it, without losing profile identity or ad/media behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source commit 66614852ea3163b6cb9eafdad2db3c02a8f7558a was inspected on 2026-11-17. This establishes the PR source baseline only; it does not establish the installed Android binary, runtime OTA or production deployment fingerprint.
chosenApproach: Keep avatar and identity column with a one-line author, quick note, rank/audience and compact date; use a right-side action rail with Follow first and Report beneath; keep own-post Edit/Delete menu and existing callback authorization unchanged.
selectionRationale: The preceding layout grouped Follow, Report and the timestamp horizontally in a lower row, creating an unnecessarily tall/empty band on mobile.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Adjust only the display hierarchy of the existing tabbed Community Wall post header, preserving native runtime and media loading contracts.
preservedBehaviors: Unchanged ad placements, feed hydration, post media, likes, comments and author permissions.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Keep tappable profile name and avatar while moving follower and report actions to the right, without changing navigation or auth logic.
preservedBehaviors: User profile navigation and account/scope visibility authorization remain unchanged.

preserveBehaviors: Following/Unfollowing optimistic state and rollback are unchanged.
Owner Edit/Delete/author-only and other-user Report actions remain intact.
Post metadata remains one line each and author Note chip remains visible.
Post image/video, comment, reactions and AdMob rendering remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Updated compact-layout source contract checks the new right-side vertical action rail rather than the old date/action band.
Updated Wall header regression and existing identity/privacy checks must pass.
Required engineering accountability scope gate must pass before merge.
Android runtime test, exact frozen RC and staging OTA verification are separate release gates.
Navigation-scroll impact has focused Wall header navigation regression coverage; no scroll mechanics are changed.
alternativeApproaches: Retain a standalone action row: rejected because it wastes post-header height.
Put all controls beside the name on one horizontal line: rejected because Report must be beneath Following.
releaseTarget: staging-user runtime 1.3.2 only after verified RC
